note:
R50 — PS4 goal horns: `exhibitionarena.goalhorn` joined to the shipped `creation_zone_csv/goalhorns.csv` catalogue (NHL 17–21) and the
catalogue's `audioid` space checked against the SND10 banks (read-only).

Per title: the CSV columns and row classes (premade team horns / generic horns / horn elements / flairs), the DB `goalhorn` value census,
the join rules tested — DB value = CSV `audioid` (direct), = `audioid + 1`, = `index`, = `index + 1` — scored on the NHL arenas by whether
the resolved row's identifier names the arena's NHL club (city + club-name tokens), and on every arena by resolution rate; the `periodhorn`
and `goalhornelement1..3` / `goalhornflair` columns likewise; then the CSV `audioid` values looked up as `.SID` in every `.sbr` under
`audio/` (which bank, if any, carries them).
Usage: python r50_ps4_goalhorn_csv_join.py <out.json>
